about.title: About Gilbert Public Schools
about.content: Gilbert Public Schools serves families in the Phoenix East Valley. Its family calendars are useful for planning because the district publishes several approved future years and marks one-hour early releases, K–12 half days, K–6 conference half days, grading days, semester counts, and teacher start dates directly on the PDF.

about.title: District Calendar and School Schedules
about.content: This page summarizes districtwide Gilbert Public Schools dates. Families should still check their school for bell schedules, transportation notices, testing, athletics, performances, graduation information, summer school registration details, and campus-specific updates.

planningTips.title: Gilbert Public Schools Calendar Notes
content: GPS uses one-hour early-release days throughout the year, often on Wednesdays.
Some half days apply to all K–12 students, while parent-teacher conference half days are listed specifically for K–6.
The district publishes semester day counts on its family calendar PDFs, so the first and second semesters do not always contain the same number of student days.
Summer school dates are listed on the family calendar, but families should confirm registration and program details with Gilbert Public Schools.

districtFaqs.q: Does Gilbert Public Schools publish future-year calendars?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. Gilbert Public Schools currently publishes family calendar PDFs for multiple future school years, including 2027-2028, 2028-2029, and 2029-2030.

districtFaqs.q: What does early release mean on the GPS calendar?
districtFaqs.a: The GPS family calendar labels many early-release dates as one-hour early releases. Families should still confirm exact dismissal times with their school.

districtFaqs.q: Are all Gilbert Public Schools half days the same?
districtFaqs.a: No. Some half days apply to all K–12 students, while conference half days may apply only to K–6 and some end-of-semester half days apply only to grades 7–12.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify Gilbert Public Schools calendar updates?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official Gilbert Public Schools calendar page and school announcements for final confirmation. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and is not affiliated with Gilbert Public Schools.
